selection: same six frozen reports, no replacement or revision of revenue forecasts
measure: reported consolidated operating profit FN86, not adjusted EBIT or NOPAT
benchmark: existing current_rule_fy_bridge revenue times origin TTM FN86 / origin TTM FN230; explicit companion benchmark, not a production operating-profit forecast
eligibility: explicit FY E columns and million CNY unit; all printed historical operating-profit cells match same-year TDX FN86 at printed precision; absent or ambiguous rows blocked, no zero imputation
metrics: operating-profit mean absolute error / actual FY revenue
paired revenue errors on identical eligible positions
decision: diagnostic only; no DCF adoption even if reported operating-profit error improves because adjusted EBIT components and capital needs remain unclosed; no threshold tuning or posthoc model mixing
boundary: later-acquired versions and exposed overlapping targets; not strict PIT, consensus forecast or independent validation
